text:
ryan m: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A: teams asked for clarifications on a few non-obvious rollout items for API / Console / Optimize (localization, analytics hooks, rate-limit migration). cc @jess carter
jess carter: good catch. short answers: localization for Console will be incremental (EN first, then EU languages in beta2), analytics hooks for API will be available at GA, and rate-limit migration plan is opt-in with a default grace period. details below.
nina (compliance): for EU customers, is data residency/processing changing during Console beta? legal asked for a clear statement to give customers.
jess carter: no change to residency commitments for Dedicated customers. Console beta will run in the same VPCs/regions as now for pilot customers. any pilot that requires additional residency controls will be handled OOB via the concierge.
tara (intl): localization ask: will Console UI strings be externalized for translation and can devs contribute? our intl team needs lead time.
jess carter: yes, strings will be externalized and well open a translation workflow. beta1 = EN-only, beta2 = localized for FR/DE/ES. ETA for beta2 will be communicated in the one-pager.
hao (eng-infra): analytics hooks = what exactly? we need endpoints/events to instrument. will there be a schema + pilot telemetry pipeline?
jess carter: API GA will emit structured events for request metadata (route, model_family, latency_ms, error_code) to our telemetry endpoint. we'll publish a schema and sample ingestion config for infra/billing by GA.
nina (compliance): any changes to audit logging for Console? customers want immutable logs + export.
jess carter: audit logs remain mandatory for enterprise; Console beta adds export capability (S3 or syslog) and retention controls in the admin panel.
nina (compliance): good. please add a compliance checklist to the one-pager with required posture for pilots.
jess carter: will do.
ryan m: rate-limit migration question: some apps still use old token model. what's the timeline and will we auto-migrate rate limits?
jess carter: new rate-limit model will be offered alongside old for 60 days post-GA. default = keep old limits unless tenant opts into new per-route quotas. we won't auto-upgrade without consent.
tara (intl): Optimize question: will cost-savings reports include localized pricing adjustments (eg. region-specific GPU costs)? finance needs that to present to customers.
jess carter: Optimize v1 will show estimated compute savings using region-aware unit costs for Dedicated pools. hosted estimates will use our standard region pricing table.
hao (eng-infra): practical infra ask: for fallback variants, do we need pre-warmed containers per region, or is a cold-start acceptable?
jess carter: requirement: pre-warmed fallback in primary regions (NA/EU) only; cold-start acceptable in secondary regions. we'll publish exact pre-warm counts per model family.
nina (compliance): one more: are there any changes to the consent/audit flows we should prepare for with Console integrations (SCIM/OIDC)?
jess carter: Console beta supports SCIM + OIDC for SSO; audit flows remain the same. pilot customers may request additional hooks; include in concierge scope.
ryan m: request: can product publish a 1-page addendum that covers localization, analytics schema link, rate-limit migration plan, and compliance checklist? teams need to link this in sprint plans.
jess carter: yes  we'll append the addendum to the main one-pager. tagging @ops-bot to create a tracking ticket and attach owners.
ops-bot: Created RW-ADD-8420 "Roadmap addendum: localization, analytics, rate-limit migration, compliance checklist" assigned to jess carter, tara (intl), hao (eng-infra), due 2026-07-08.
ryan m: thanks. can we get the analytics schema and rate-limit FAQ before EOD Friday? we'll freeze instrumentation changes.
jess carter: i'll aim to post the schema + FAQ by Thursday EOD. if anything slips, will update the tracking ticket.
tara (intl): great, i'll block translation slots and start vendor outreach.
hao (eng-infra): i'll schedule infra freeze windows around the dates in the one-pager and link tasks to RW-ADD-8420.
nina (compliance): thanks folks. i'll review the compliance checklist once posted and flag anything EU-specific.
jess carter: appreciated. once the addendum's up i'll post a short thread in #all-hands with links and owners. :white_check_mark:
